calculation_or_source: Borrowing Base Certificate definition references Exhibit A or another form reasonably acceptable to Agent; targeted search found no populated Exhibit A form in filed text
what_it_says: The filed agreement points to a certificate form but does not expose a populated certificate or detailed form table.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not prove the certificate form is unavailable from lender files or omitted schedules outside the SEC exhibit text.
next_source: Search exhibit package, lender syndication materials, rating reports, and any future certificate exhibits

calculation_or_source: Agent and Lenders shall have received a Borrowing Base Certificate prepared as of the last business day of calendar month ended May 31 2025
what_it_says: A real certificate existed for the closing package as of May 31 2025.
what_it_does_not_say: The actual certificate values and component lines are not included in the filed agreement text.

calculation_or_source: Combined Availability as of Closing Date after the transactions must not be less than 1000 million USD
what_it_says: The closing package had a minimum availability gate.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show actual closing-date Combined Availability beyond being at least the threshold.

source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 Borrowing Base Certificate definition
calculation_or_source: Certificate must set forth calculation of U.S. Borrowing Base and each component
what_it_says: The live certificate should show U.S. borrowing-base components.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not provide the component values.

source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 Borrowing Base Certificate definition
calculation_or_source: Certificate must set forth calculation of Canadian Borrowing Base and each component
what_it_says: The live certificate should show Canadian borrowing-base components.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not provide the component values.

value: Eligible merchandise and consumables inventory value
calculation_or_source: U.S. base uses Merchandise and Consumables Inventory Formula Amount equal to 60% of Value of Eligible Merchandise and Consumables Inventory
what_it_says: A certificate must support the eligible inventory value feeding the 60% formula.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show eligible inventory dollars or exclusions.
next_source: Borrowing Base Certificate and inventory collateral schedule

value: Eligible rental equipment Net Book Value
source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 U.S. and Canadian Borrowing Base definitions
calculation_or_source: Rental-equipment formula uses lesser of 100% Net Book Value and 85% Net Orderly Liquidation Value
what_it_says: A certificate or support schedule must include eligible rental-equipment NBV or a derived input.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show NBV by fleet class or geography.
next_source: Borrowing Base Certificate and fixed-asset collateral schedule

value: Eligible rental equipment Net Orderly Liquidation Value
source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 U.S. and Canadian Borrowing Base definitions
calculation_or_source: Rental-equipment formula uses 85% of Net Orderly Liquidation Value based on most recent appraisal
what_it_says: A certificate or appraisal support schedule must include NOLV inputs.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show NOLV dollars or appraisal date.

source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 U.S. and Canadian Borrowing Base definitions
calculation_or_source: Both U.S. and Canadian borrowing-base formulas subtract Pari Passu Debt Reserves
what_it_says: A certificate should show or support any pari passu reserve deduction.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show reserve dollars.
next_source: Borrowing Base Certificate and reserve notices

calculation_or_source: Borrowing-base formulas subtract other reserves established by Agent, including Availability Reserves and other Reserves
what_it_says: A certificate should show reserve deductions or a support schedule should explain them.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show current reserve balances.
next_source: Borrowing Base Certificate and reserve notices

calculation_or_source: Combined Availability equals lesser of Maximum Revolver Amount and Combined Borrowing Base minus Aggregate Revolver Outstandings
what_it_says: A live availability bridge needs aggregate outstandings by tranche and L/C treatment.
what_it_does_not_say: The filed agreement does not provide the live register.
next_source: Loan register, L/C schedule, and availability report

value: Maximum Revolver Amount and Canadian maximum
source_detail: SEC Exhibit 10.1 Combined Availability and Combined Borrowing Base definitions
calculation_or_source: Combined Availability uses Maximum Revolver Amount; Combined Borrowing Base includes lesser of Canadian base and Maximum Canadian Revolver Amount
what_it_says: A certificate or availability report needs the applicable maximum caps.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show current tranche-level changes or future amendments.

value: Combined Borrowing Base and Combined Availability
calculation_or_source: Combined Borrowing Base and Combined Availability are defined outputs of component calculations
what_it_says: The live report should bridge component collateral to actual availability.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not provide live Combined Availability except disclosed reset-date 8-K snapshot and closing minimum threshold.
next_source: Borrowing Base Certificate and availability report

calculation_or_source: Suppressed Availability means Combined Borrowing Base minus Maximum Revolver Amount
what_it_says: A full collateral cushion bridge needs suppressed availability, not just stated facility availability.
what_it_does_not_say: The filed agreement does not show current suppressed availability.

value: supermajority consent for availability-increasing eligibility changes
calculation_or_source: Changes to eligibility criteria, reserves, sublimits, or advance rates that increase Combined Availability or a Borrowing Base require Supermajority Lenders and Borrowers consent, subject to agent reversal of prior adverse credit-judgment changes
what_it_says: Borrowing-base economics are lender-protected and not freely loosened by ordinary amendment consent.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show any actual amendment or waiver history.
next_source: Future amendments and lender consent records

calculation_or_source: Agent has discretion over determination of applicability of ineligibility criteria with respect to U.S. or Canadian Borrowing Base calculations
what_it_says: Eligibility is not purely mechanical; agent judgment matters within agreement terms.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show actual disputed or adjusted items.
next_source: Agent correspondence and certificate adjustment history

calculation_or_source: Collateral releases require updating U.S. or Canadian Borrowing Base to delete released assets and leave U.S. or Canadian Availability no less than before release
what_it_says: Borrowing-base value is supposed to update when collateral leaves the lien package.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not show actual collateral releases or deletions.
next_source: Collateral release records and updated certificates

value: certificate fields mapped but live values missing
calculation_or_source: Synthesis of certificate source boundary and required field map
what_it_says: We can now name the fields needed to prove live borrowing-base availability: eligible inventory value, eligible rental equipment NBV, NOLV, reserves, outstandings, caps, Combined Borrowing Base, Combined Availability, and Suppressed Availability.
what_it_does_not_say: Do not claim live borrowing-base capacity, eligible collateral dollars, reserve balances, or current legal availability until the actual certificate or equivalent report is obtained.
